decomposition.distribution_definition: SSP585 precipitation response minus the quantity-only reference-distribution path response on common-positive rainfall support
decomposition.quantity_path: uniformly scale every SSP126 monthly precipitation amount so season total equals SSP585; phase linear terms scale by ratio and monthly-square sums by ratio squared
decomposition.warning: quantity/distribution split is reference-path dependent and is not a unique causal decomposition; exact component additivity applies before loss-only adaptation, because adaptation is evaluated separately on each component's cell response

estimand: fixed MapSPAM 2000 maize production-weighted SSP5-8.5 minus SSP1-2.6 maize log-yield response, UKESM1-0-LL, 2092-2100
interpretation: preliminary response-function transport using fixed country-level PWT income and alternative 27-year GSWP3-W5E5 climate moderators; not the authors' subnational/time-varying moderator construction and not yet monetized or run through a marginal emissions pulse
uncertainty: reported standard errors propagate the published coefficient covariance only; they exclude climate-model, weather-product, moderator-transport, adaptation, crop-area, and structural uncertainty
